# Municipal Ordinance No. 08, Series of 2011

> [!warning] Misfiled Document
> The source PDF is labeled "Mun. Ord. No. 08, S-2015" but the session date is May 30, 2011 and it was enacted during the 2011 SB term. This ordinance is misfiled in the archives — the correct series year is 2011.

**An Ordinance Establishing the Community e-Center in the Municipality of Pitogo, Quezon, Regulating Its Operation and Authorizing the Collection for Other Purposes**

## Summary

This ordinance establishes the Community e-Center (CeC) in the Municipality of [[Pitogo]], Quezon, as part of the national CeC project of the [[Commission on Information and Communications Technology]] (CICT) in partnership with local government units. The Community e-Center aims to make information technology accessible to all Filipinos, particularly in underserved areas. The center provides public access to the World Wide Web, email, instant messaging, and other digital services. The ordinance regulates the operation of the e-Center and authorizes the collection of fees for its services.

## Key Provisions

1. **Establishment of Community e-Center**: The municipality establishes a Community e-Center (CeC) as a public facility for information and communications technology access.

2. **CICT Partnership**: The CeC is established in partnership with the [[Commission on Information and Communications Technology]] (CICT) under the national CeC program.

3. **Services Provided**: The e-Center provides public access to:
   - World Wide Web (internet browsing)
   - Email services
   - Instant messaging
   - Other digital communication and information services

4. **Operational Regulations**: Establishes rules and guidelines for the operation and management of the Community e-Center.

5. **Fee Collection**: Authorizes the collection of fees for the use of e-Center services and facilities.

6. **Purpose**: Makes information technology accessible to the residents of Pitogo, bridging the digital divide in the municipality.
